turns.replyText:
To get the best result from a Rug & Pad Set:

Clear the space before setting up the pad, since it’s difficult to move once assembled.
Lay out the numbered pad pieces for your rug size. Align the interlocking teeth and press them down until they’re flush.
Place the rug cover on top, then tuck each corner of the pad into the matching patented corner pocket on the underside.
Center the cover and smooth wrinkles from the middle outward.
Once it’s flat, gently pull the cover taut and apply the included corner grippers before placing furniture on it.

For care, remove the Rug Cover from the Cushioned Rug Pad before washing. The cover is machine wash-and-dryable, but the pad is not machine-washable. If you wash the cover, let it air-dry flat until completely dry and gently pull it taut while it dries. Keep the set on a hard floor for the most stable result; a low-pile, firm carpet may work but can feel less stable.
